scope: Pretest VMware saved-memory file with client processes open; no controlled synthetic ChatGPT turn had yet been submitted for this follow-up cohort
acquisition_type: VMware powered-on snapshot .vmem, not WinPmem raw
process_selection: All rows with the exact process name, null ExitTime in windows.pslist, and an exact --type=renderer argument in windows.cmdline; no PID age or known content selector
reader: Volatility windows.memmap gives guest physical addresses; MemProcFS reads those addresses through VMware metadata. A flat seek into the .vmem file is not valid for all mappings.
grammars_applied_to_each_selected_render: bounded stream-item JSON in UTF-8 and UTF-16LE
bounded backendConversationId/messages state JSON in UTF-8 and UTF-16LE
interpretation: Neither tested grammar found an accepted record in this pretest client-open state. This does not identify open tabs, verify account sign-in from RAM, or prove that no unrelated conversation data existed. It is a format-specific baseline, not a scored conversation trial.
